text:
Asha: Quick heads-up — Marigold gave a really strong quote on our call this morning. Want to turn it into a short customer story + webinar. Need: interview scheduling, quote signoff/legal OK for publish, and inbound lead routing for webinar attendees. Proposed dates: Apr 7 or Apr 9. @Ritu legal FYI. @Ben pls bucket for webinar comms.

Ben: Nice. What timezone are they in? I can hold a 30-min slot at 10am PT (1pm ET). Do we want live demo + Q&A or prerecorded clip + live Q&A?

Clara: They're PST and prefer live demo + Q&A. Suggested question set to keep it tight:
```
1) What problem were you trying to solve?
2) How did you evaluate options?
3) What results did you see (metrics / qualitative)?
4) Implementation time + team involvement
5) Advice for teams considering Redwood
```

Liam: I'll handle Zoom recording + webinar streaming link. Need participant names, titles, and headshots for the landing page. @Asha can you confirm product rep? Also confirm if they want us to record the demo for an asset library.

Asha: Product rep is Tony — he can do 20-min demo + 10-min Q&A. Tony, can you confirm slides and availability? Also pulling the quote we captured from notes: "Redwood cut our inference costs by 42% and latency improved 3x" — can we publish that verbatim or do we need to soften? @Ritu tagging for legal.

Tony: I can do it. I'll rehearse and share slides by Monday. For the quote, if legal or the customer prefers we can soften to "significantly lowered inference costs". Marigold can confirm.

Ritu: Quick legal check — we need evidence to publish specific numbers (42%, 3x). If you have a metrics export or eval report, include it. Otherwise we should use qualitative wording: "significantly reduced inference costs" and avoid revenue stats unless customer signs off and CS agrees. Also we need a signed release form from the customer for quotes + recording.

Asha: I have the quarterly metrics export; will check with CS and Marigold for permission to publish. I'll draft a one-paragraph release and the e-sign link today.

Ben: Marketing copy idea for the launch post — include benchmark callout and CTA to register for the webinar. Draft: 
```
Marigold scales real-time ML with Redwood Inference — cutting costs and boosting latency. Join us Apr 7 to hear their story and see a live demo. Register now: [link]
```

Clara: Lead routing plan: webinar signup -> landing page /webinar/marigold. Attendee + engaged (asked a question or clicked demo CTA) -> route to HubSpot list 'webinar-engaged' then assign to Tony + SDR queue 'mid-market'. Zap: webhook event `webinar.attend` -> HubSpot list ID 98321.

Tony: Kayla (SDR) will own follow-up. Suggested cadence: Day 0 (1 day): recording + thank you, Day 3: tips + short case excerpt, Day 7: demo offer. @Ben pls build nurture.

CalendarBot: Event created — Marigold Customer Story Webinar — Apr 7 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT).

Asha: Great. I'll get the release signoff and send the calendar invite to Marigold + PR contact. @Ritu flag if you need any additional language constraints. Target publish date for blog + registration page: 2026-04-01 to build signups.

Ritu: Works for legal. Reminder: avoid disclosing customer revenue or contract values without explicit CFO approval. Please add the customer PR contact to the threads once you have them.

Asha: Added Marigold PR contact: emma@marigold.ai (emailed for quote approval). Will update when we have signed release.

Ben: :thumbsup: I'll mock the landing page and webinar banner and share designs by EOD Friday.

Tony: I'll upload slides to the shared drive and drop a dry-run invite for next Wednesday.

Clara: Noted — I'll prepare the short case study outline for ops and the copy snippets for the landing page.

Asha: Thanks team — next steps: I will (1) get legal + customer signoff on quote, (2) lock webinar date Apr 7, (3) share release form for signature, (4) confirm hubspot zap with Ben + Clara.

Ben: Sounds good. Ping if anything blocks.

(thumbsup reaction from Clara)
